component-o.description-s: 2.5-5.5 V input, 3 A, 1.5 MHz synchronous step-down converter, adjustable output 0.6 V to VIN, SOT-563 (DRL)

cfgpins-ao.4c: EN high (VIH 1.2 V max) enables, do not leave floating: tied to VIN

cfgpins-ao.5c: VFB 0.6 V; VOUT = 0.6 V x (1 + R1/R2): R1 200k / R2 100k gives the row's 1.8 V (Figure 4 / Table 3 p9, R2 not above 100k per 8.2.2.2); C3 feed-forward optional, not fitted

cfgpins-ao.6c: NC: leave open, or connect to the output or AGND (Pin Functions p4)

specs-o.en_note-s: no internal pull: the EN input must be terminated and not left floating

en_source-o.table-s: 6.5 Electrical Characteristics, LOGIC INTERFACE EN: VIH 1.2 V, VIL 0.4 V (VIN = 2.5 V to 5.5 V)

specs-o.replaces_s: TLV62568DBVR / TPS82130SILR on 1.8 V rails: same 0.6 V VFB and 2.5-5.5 V input as TLV62568, but SOT-563 with a different pin order (GND/SW/VIN/EN/FB/NC)

vref_source-o.table-s: 6.5 Electrical Characteristics, OUTPUT: VFB 594 / 600 / 606 mV (0 to 85 C), 588 / 600 / 612 mV (-40 to 125 C), PWM mode

cout_source-o.table-s: 8.2.2.5: 'designed to operate with an output capacitor of 10 uF to 47 uF, as outlined in Table 4'; Table 4 p10: 1 uH with 10 / 22 (typical) / 47 uF; above 47 uF a feed-forward capacitor is needed; 10 uF input 'sufficient for most applications'

iout_source-o.table-s: 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: IOUT output current 0 to 3 A

specs-o.loop_note-s: adaptive off-time peak-current control, internally compensated; a feed-forward capacitor C3 across R1 'reduces the output ripple in PSM and improves the load transient response', 22 pF for the 1.8 V typical application (8.2.2.5 p11); no bandwidth figure

load_transient-ao.slew_note-s: edge not stated; read off the capture: about 16 us for 0.1 -> 3 A at 100 us/div
load_transient-ao.cout_part-s: C2 GRM21BD70J226ME44 22 uF 6.3 V X7T 0805 (Table 3 p9)
load_transient-ao.conditions_source-s: Application Curves header p12: VIN = 5 V, VOUT = 1.8 V, TA = 25 C unless otherwise noted; circuit Figure 4 / Table 3 (p9), C3 optional and not fitted (Figure 19 is the C3 case)
load_transient-ao.read-s: oscilloscope capture rendered at 600 dpi: 0.1 V/div = 138.5 px, about +/-10 mV; starts in Power Save Mode (sawtooth): undershoot on 0.1 -> 3 A 114 mV below the PSM mean (90 mV below the ripple floor), overshoot on 3 -> 0.1 A 104 mV above the loaded PWM level

load_transient-ao.slew_note-s: edge not stated; read off the capture: about 16 us for 0.1 -> 3 A at 100 us/div
load_transient-ao.cout_part-s: C2 GRM21BD70J226ME44 22 uF 6.3 V X7T 0805 (Table 3 p9)
load_transient-ao.conditions_source-s: Application Curves header p12; C3 = 22 pF feed-forward across R1
load_transient-ao.fig-s: Figure 19. Load Transient with A Feedforward Capacitor
load_transient-ao.read-s: 600 dpi render, 0.1 V/div = 138 px: undershoot 93 mV below the PSM mean, overshoot 80 mV above the loaded PWM level

specs-o.load_transient_note-s: Both figures step from 0.1 A (Power Save Mode) to 3 A with a slow edge (about 0.18 A/us, read off the capture, not stated). A faster edge would deepen the dip; the 114 mV / 2.9 A = 0.039 ohm still leaves about 2.8x margin to 0.110 ohm

load_regulation_source-o.table-s: Figure 9. Load Regulation (VIN 5 V; curve points via pdf-graph)

specs-o.load_regulation_note-s: Figure 9 starts at 0.5 A; below that the converter is in Power Save Mode, where VOUT sits slightly above nominal (7.3.1)
specs-o.efficiency_source-s: pdf-graph curve points, VIN = 5.0 V trace, L = 1 uH, TA = 25 C (p12 header)
specs-o.inductor_note-s: Table 4 p10: 1 uH is the typical application (0.47 uH and 2.2 uH not checked); Table 3 L1 Coilcraft XFL4020-102ME 1 uH 4 x 4 x 1.5 mm; saturation current 20-30 % above IL,MAX (Equation 3, 8.2.2.4). ILIM 4.0 A min
specs-o.rth_source-s: 6.4 Thermal Information p5: RthJA DRL (SOT) 132.7 C/W (JEDEC board); Figure 22 p14: 45 C rise at 3 A, 1.8 V out, 5 V in on the EVM
